title: Rule declarations
description: extensions/rules/<name>.json: declared rules, which judge the resolved model without a script. Each rule selects objects, requires a condition of each of them and reports x/<id> with its message where the condition does not hold.

id.description: The rule's id: its findings are x/<id>, and validation.rules sets their severity by that name. Unique across declarations and rule scripts (MQ5015).

severity.description: The findings' severity, unless validation.rules sets another.

description.description: What the rule checks, in a sentence.

require.description: What must hold for each selected object; a finding where it does not.

message.description: The finding's text. {<path>} inserts the value at a path of the object, {$count} the number the top-level count, references or referencedBy found, and {{ and }} write braces.

values.description: One value or a list; a list means any of its values.

selector.description: Which resolved objects the rule judges. The keys combine with AND.

kind.description: Resolved kinds, such as entity, attribute, table or column.

stereotype.description: Stereotype keys: objects whose effective stereotypes hold one of them.

tag.description: Tag keys: objects whose tags hold one of them.

property.description: Custom property names: objects that hold a non-null value for one of them.

package.description: Package ids: objects in one of the packages or a package nested in it (a table falls back to its entity's or relation's package).

path.description: Members as scripts see them, in camel case, joined by dots: a map key after a map (properties.retentionDays, calculated.publicName) and a member of an object after an object (table.name).

condition.description: Exactly one operator: all, any and not combine; has, equals, count, references and referencedBy test.

any.description: Holds when at least one condition holds.

not.description: Holds when the condition does not.

has.description: Holds when the value at the path is present: not null, an empty string, an empty list or an empty map.

equals.description: Holds when the value at the path equals value; null matches a null or missing value.

value.description: Strings compare ordinally, numbers by value; an enum member by its JSON name, a resolved object by its id.

count.description: Holds when the number of objects in the list at of for which where holds (all when absent) is at least min and at most max; min is 1 when both are absent.

of.description: A path that ends at a list of objects, such as columns, attributes, members or indexes.

where.description: A condition relative to each item.

references.description: Holds when the object links to at least min (default 1) and at most max objects of kind, through field when given.

referencedBy.description: Holds when at least min (default 1) and at most max objects of kind link to the object, through field when given.

kind.description: Element kinds or part kinds as the index names them (attribute, enum-member, column, row...).
